text: The purpose of this report is to authorize the reimbursement of legal fees to a former Member of City Council under the Indemnification for Members of Council Policy.

City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the reimbursement of legal fees paid to Fenton, Smith Barristers in the amount of $6,889.47 as requested by a former Member of City Council.
